title: River Development Agent Controlled Executor Verified Receipt Acceptance Foundation
objective: Deterministically accept or reject a verified DEV-258 execution receipt verification result as inert downstream decision data. Acceptance must require a trusted, ready, verified, deny-by-default, verification-only predecessor with valid receipt identity, recognized receipt state, approved execution scope, provenance, authorization boundaries, scope boundaries, and preserved authority exclusions. Acceptance does not authorize dispatch, execution, inspection invocation, retry, lifecycle-state persistence, repository mutation, staging, commit, push, deployment, secret access, scope expansion, arbitrary shell execution, or external side effects.
acceptanceRules: acceptance fails closed unless DEV-258 version is exact
acceptance fails closed unless DEV-258 trusted is true
acceptance fails closed unless DEV-258 ready is true
acceptance fails closed unless DEV-258 verified is true
acceptance fails closed unless defaultPolicy is DENY
acceptance fails closed unless verificationOnly is true
acceptance fails closed unless embedded receipt version is DEV-257
acceptance fails closed unless executed operation is inspect-approved-repository-state
acceptance fails closed unless receipt state is recognized
acceptance fails closed without approved execution scope
acceptance fails closed without authorization boundaries
acceptance fails closed without scope boundaries
acceptance fails closed if any prohibited authority is granted
acceptance itself grants no downstream side-effect authority
requiredPredecessorEvidence: embedded DEV-257 receipt version equals DEV-257

authorityBoundary.verifiedReceiptAcceptanceAuthority: GRANTED FOR INERT ACCEPTANCE DECISION ONLY

implementationConstraints: DEV-259 must consume DEV-258 verification data only.
DEV-259 must treat acceptance as inert decision data only.
DEV-259 must not create an execution authorization.
DEV-259 must not execute an operation.
DEV-259 must not persist lifecycle state.
DEV-259 must not mutate repository state.
DEV-259 must preserve approved execution scope without expansion.
DEV-259 must preserve verification and authorization provenance.
DEV-259 must fail closed for malformed predecessor data.
DEV-259 must fail closed if any prohibited predecessor authority is granted.
DEV-259 must not modify protected integration surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: DEV-259 begins directly from DEV-258 commit b452ff9.
A valid DEV-258 verification is accepted.
A non-verified DEV-258 result is rejected.
An untrusted DEV-258 result is rejected.
A non-ready DEV-258 result is rejected.
Wrong embedded receipt version is rejected.
Missing approved execution scope is rejected.
Any prohibited predecessor authority causes rejection.
Acceptance performs no execution or inspection invocation.
Acceptance performs no retry or lifecycle-state mutation.
